content.user_title: Upscale Images and Videos With FAL Guidance
content.value_statement: Low-resolution media can be hard to reuse in design, product, and marketing work. This skill gives concise guidance for AI-assisted image and video upscaling workflows.
actual_capabilities: Guides requests for AI image upscaling and enhancement.
Guides requests for AI video resolution enhancement.
Helps decide when a media upscaling workflow is appropriate.
Provides general instruction patterns for resolution improvement tasks.
Links to the upstream FAL AI community skill source for reference.
limitations: Does not include executable integration code or direct API calls.
Does not document authentication, pricing, or service limits.
Does not guarantee output quality for every source image or video.
Does not provide detailed model settings or parameter tables.

use_cases.title: Restore Product Assets
use_cases.description: Prepare clearer product images from older or compressed source files before design review.

use_cases.title: Improve Social Video Clips
use_cases.description: Plan a video enhancement request for clips that need higher resolution or cleaner detail.

use_cases.title: Prepare Visual References
use_cases.description: Create an upscaling workflow for reference media used in presentations or creative briefs.

prompt_templates.title: Upscale One Image
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single low-resolution image.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me upscale this image for clean web use. Preserve the original subject, colors, and composition.

prompt_templates.title: Enhance A Video Clip
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for short video improvement.
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide me through enhancing this short video clip. Prioritize sharper detail, stable motion, and natural results.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Enhancement Goals
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning before choosing an upscaling approach.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my media goal and suggest an upscaling strategy. Compare clarity, file size, processing time, and artifact risk.

prompt_templates.title: Plan A Batch Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow for multiple related assets.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a batch upscaling plan for these assets. Group them by media type, quality issues, and final delivery needs.

output_examples.input: Upscale a compressed product image for a storefront banner.
output_examples.output: A concise plan that preserves product shape, improves edge clarity, and prepares a web-ready enhanced image.

output_examples.input: Improve a short event video recorded at low resolution.
output_examples.output: A guided enhancement request focused on clearer detail, stable motion, and avoiding unnatural sharpening.

output_examples.input: Prepare several mixed media assets for a campaign review.
output_examples.output: A grouped workflow that separates images and videos, defines quality goals, and lists review checks.

best_practices: Start with the highest quality source file available.
State the final use, target size, and preferred visual style.
Review results for artifacts before using them in production.
anti_patterns: Do not upscale heavily blurred media without setting realistic expectations.
Do not request changes that alter important product or brand details.
Do not treat upscaling as a substitute for source asset management.

faq.answer: No. It provides prompt guidance only and does not include executable API integration code.

faq.question: Can it help with both images and videos?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill description covers image and video resolution enhancement workflows.

faq.question: Will the output always look better?

faq.answer: Yes. The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
